LanguageData.Bow_ChuKoNu.label: Chu-Ko-Nu
LanguageData.Bow_ChuKoNu.description: The Chu-Ko-Nu is a repeating crossbow invented in China at the end of the second century AD, fires 3 arrows in a burst.
LanguageData.Bow_ChuKoNu.verbs.Verb_Shoot.label: Chu-Ko-Nu
LanguageData.Bullet_ShouChong.label: shou chong bullet
LanguageData.Gun_Hwacha.label: hwacha
LanguageData.Gun_Hwacha.description: A hwacha was a multiple rocket launcher developed by Koreans and deployed in the defence of Korea against Japanese invasion in the 1590s. It had the ability to fire multiple singijeon, a type of fire arrow rocket, at one time.
LanguageData.Gun_Hwacha.verbs.Verb_Shoot.label: hwacha
LanguageData.Gun_ShouChong.label: shou chong
LanguageData.Gun_ShouChong.description: A shou chong is chinese hand cannon, one of the early forms of firearm. It is possibly the oldest type of small arms, as well as the simplest type of early firearm, as most examples require direct manual external ignition through a touch hole without any form of firing mechanism.
LanguageData.Gun_ShouChong.verbs.Verb_Shoot.label: shou chong
LanguageData.Proj_ZhenTianLei.label: Zhen-Tian-Lei
LanguageData.Projectile_Shuriken.label: shuriken
LanguageData.Shuriken.label: shuriken
LanguageData.Shuriken.description: A shuriken is a traditional Japanese concealed weapon that was generally used for throwing, and sometimes stabbing or slashing.
LanguageData.Shuriken.verbs.Verb_Shoot.label: shuriken
LanguageData.ZhenTianLei.label: Zhen-Tian-Lei
LanguageData.ZhenTianLei.description: The Zhen-Tian-Lei, or thunder crash bomb, is an early type of bomb or hand grenade developed in the 12th-13th century Song and Jin-era China. Its shell was made of cast iron and filled with gunpowder.
